items.en: Ukraine's Pluton detection system upgraded to detect the mesh-network modems of Russian Geran, Gerbera and Molniya drones
items.nl: Oekraïens detectiesysteem Pluton kan nu de mesh-netwerkmodems van Russische Geran-, Gerbera- en Molniya-drones detecteren
items.sEn: The Ukrainian company INFOZAHYST told Militarnyi that its Pluton drone-detection ESM system has been upgraded to detect the mesh modems used in Russian Geran-, Gerbera- and Molniya-type drones. items.en: Kyiv's air defence crews struggle to keep pace with Russia's jet-powered Geran drones
items.nl: Luchtverdedigers rond Kyiv hebben moeite Russische Geran-drones met straalmotor bij te houden
items.sEn: A Kyiv Independent field report (26 October 2026), based on two days with Ukraine's 112th Separate Territorial Defense Brigade outside Kyiv, describes how jet-powered Geran drones, used against Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast since late summer, are straining the capital's layered air defence.
